proposals.statement: Dispatch happens on WhatsApp with drivers replying to messages in a group, causing collections to be missed because messages get buried

evidence.quote: Dispatch happens on WhatsApp. The controller posts the collections in a group, the drivers reply, and then somebody types it all into a shared spreadsheet at night. We miss collections because messages get buried.

proposals.statement: The app must ensure every collection is assigned and confirmed

evidence.quote: So the app has to make sure every collection is assigned and confirmed.

proposals.statement: The app must handle a hundred and twenty collections per day, with a potential increase to two hundred and sixty in December

evidence.quote: About a hundred and twenty a day. In November and December it roughly doubles.
On the bad days in December we've had two hundred and sixty.

proposals.statement: The app must prevent re-delivery costs of eighteen hundred rand per missed collection

evidence.quote: A re-delivery is about eighteen hundred rand, and we lose the client's trust, which is worse. Last December we lost one retail account over it.

proposals.statement: The app must maintain client trust by preventing lost retail accounts due to missed collections

evidence.quote: A re-delivery is about eighteen hundred rand, and we lose the client's trust, which is worse. Last December we lost one retail account over it.

proposals.statement: Drivers need to accept jobs, mark collections, take photos of waybills, and get signatures while working offline due to poor signal between Colesberg and Beaufort West

evidence.quote: Accept the job, mark it collected, take a photo of the waybill, and get a signature. But you must understand, between Colesberg and Beaufort West there's no signal for hours. It has to work offline and send everything when they're back in range.

proposals.statement: The app must work offline and sync data when drivers return to internet coverage

evidence.quote: It has to work offline and send everything when they're back in range.

proposals.statement: The client uses a truck tracking system from a vendor and Sage for invoicing

evidence.quote: Our trucks have a tracking system from a vendor, so we can see where they are. And invoicing runs on Sage.

proposals.statement: Most drivers have Android smartphones, but some use basic phones

evidence.quote: Most have Android phones, their own. I think they all do, but I'd have to check.

evidence.quote: I'd want to show her a figure by the end of January.
